description: Gridfinity-compatible organiser for a 422 × 425 × 69 mm long-implement drawer: a 10 × 10 grid of the drawer-organiser's 5×5 tiles, a flared and an unflared container split by a continuous diagonal (3 + 3 cells at the front, 2 + 4 at the rear), two 2×9 slots each built from the printed 2×5 half plus a 2×4 back piece, and a 4×1 across their front, with an assembly preview.
printing_notes: Floor (420 x 420mm): two drawer_baseplate_5x5 in the front row and two drawer_baseplate_5x5_back behind, downloaded from the drawer-organiser project. The tile seam falls at columns 5|6. Lower each tile onto its neighbours so the edge tabs drop into their slots; do not press them together in-plane.

The wide pair (columns 1-6) is four distinct pieces split 5 + 5 on the tile seam: drawer_long_container_left_front and _left_back (flared) and drawer_long_container_centre_front and _centre_back. Print one of each; the boundary between them is a single diagonal wall.
Each narrow slot is the already printed drawer_long_container_2x10_half (front five cells) plus drawer_long_container_2x9_back (back four cells). Print two of each, one per slot.
Print drawer_long_container_4x1 whole; it sits across the front of both narrow slots.
Seat every piece on the assembled baseplate to align, then glue the flat faces with CA. All pieces print flat on the bed, floor down, with no supports.

The 5mm of depth slack (425 - 420) goes at the front. The outermost +X tabs on the right-hand tiles mate with nothing and add 1.8mm to the width; if the drawer is tight against the right wall, clip them flush with side cutters.
